result.summary: The page is largely well-designed and functional. A few minor visual issues were found: horizontal content truncation in the 'Fastest near you' carousel and an ambiguous notification indicator in the header.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' row ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right edge of the screen. While this can signal horizontal scrollability, there is no visual affordance (scroll hint, partial peek with fade, or scroll indicator) confirming it is scrollable, which may confuse users.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle right-edge fade or scroll indicator, or ensure the cut-off card peeks consistently to clearly communicate horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The circular element in the top-right header contains only a small red dot with no icon or label, making its purpose (notification badge, profile, cart?) unclear.
issues.suggestion: Add a recognizable icon (e.g., bell or profile avatar) inside the circle so the red dot reads as a notification badge on a meaningful control.

issues.description: The category filter chips ('Pizza', 'Sushi', etc.) rely on light gray backgrounds with dark text; the unselected chips have relatively low contrast against the white page background, which may reduce tap-target visibility.
issues.suggestion: Slightly increase the chip background contrast or add a subtle border to make unselected chips more distinguishable.
